authority: data/LEMBALL.EXE; original Windows x86. Macintosh catalog and disassembly corroborate names and source structure; Windows ABI takes precedence.

scope.method: Repository-wide source-pattern, literal, declaration and duplicate-body screening; targeted source, original-x86 and reconstruction-history review.
scope.limitation: Screening covers the source tree. This is not a function-by-function semantic proof of all 5958 reconstructed functions. Pattern counts are candidates, not defect counts. Inline literals, every numeric constant and every inferred layout remain outside exhaustive verification.
scope.graph_limitations: Tier 2 graph verification; partial parsing and stale metadata encountered. Relevant source ranges read directly. Virtual-call and overloaded-constructor edges underreported; global operator new sometimes resolved incorrectly to CMogDir. Negative graph results were not treated as proof of absence.

screening.character_check_limit: Initializer bytes and terminating null compared at annotated original addresses; not full array padding or all inline strings.

investigated_exceptions.finding: Null-remap colour fallback reads packed ammoSize through unsigned-int pointer.
